verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents a Python scripting API and AppleScript support, so asking for a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. A Python package and AppleScript dictionary are adjacent building blocks, not a published machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
